paragraphs: This page provides an exprimental web viewer for [Octree-GS [Ren 2024]]( which is a state-of-the-art extension of [Gaussian-Splatting [Kerbl 2023]]( You can try online demo form here. The code is based on Gaussian-Splatting-WebViewers (gaussiansplatting1), which is originally based on WebGL implementation of Gaussian Splatting.
